name: print-social-family-photo-with-glass-frame-and-blob-tagline-card
title: Family Photo with Glass Frame and Blob Card
whatItIs: A candid family scene in a kitchen with a thin glass frame around the centre, a hashtag and brand pill at the top, and a white blob-shaped card overlapping the lower edge with the headline 'Less managing. More living.', an advisor avatar and a Get button.
whatItMeans: A warm candid photo with a soft blob card feels human and reassuring, and the frame focuses on the play moment.
techniques: Glass frame highlighting the centre of a photo
Blob-shaped card cut by the photo elements
Blurred foreground family members for depth
Headline with bold sans and italic name
Brand pill and hashtag in the frame corners

vocabulary.definition: A thin translucent border framing part of an image.
A card with soft irregular contour edges.
Out-of-focus objects in front of the subject.
